entries.title: Psalms 124:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents. Of David.>> "If it had not been the LORD who was on our side," Let Israel now say-

entries.title: Psalms 124:2
segments: "If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, When men rose up against us,

entries.title: Psalms 124:3
segments: Then they would have swallowed us alive, When their wrath was kindled against us;

entries.title: Psalms 124:4
segments: Then the waters would have overwhelmed us, The stream would have gone over our soul;

entries.title: Psalms 124:5
segments: Then the swollen waters Would have gone over our soul."

entries.title: Psalms 124:6
segments: ¶Blessed [be] the LORD, Who has not given us [as] prey to their teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 124:7
segments: Our soul has escaped as a bird from the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

entries.title: Psalms 124:8
segments: Our help [is] in the name of the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
